skill.name: speak
skill.description: Converts agent replies into natural spoken output for any TTS engine with text normalization, prosody control, and voice preference learning. Use when output will be read aloud, when writing for text to speech, or when the user corrects pronunciation, pacing, or voice choice.
skill.summary: Turns written agent replies into speech-ready text for any TTS engine and adapts voice, rate, and phrasing to the user over time. Learned preferences live in `~/clawic/speak/preferences.md`; the skill reads and writes on
